text: These blue balls are Gravity Cells. Each one holds a little bit of stolen gravity.
Run into them to collect them. Jump with the JUMP button. Grab all six!
Six cells! I counted them. Twice.
Bounce pads throw you high into the air. Some of these cells are right up high.
And the bubble by the tower has hardly any gravity in it. Jump inside and float!
That bubble was brilliant.
That's what Zero's machine does, but to whole cities.
Zero's henchbots are called Floaters. These are my practice ones.
Your watch fires a Gravity Bubble. Press USE near a Floater and pop, off it floats!
I am glad I am not a Floater.
Last one. Your watch has a tractor beam too. Stand next to a block and press USE to pick it up.
Carry it onto the glowing pad and press USE again to drop it. Three blocks!
Training complete. Now, I'm afraid, the real thing.
The cells are up on the arcade roof and the tower next to it. Take the stairs, or bounce up on the pads.
The pink pad on the arcade roof goes really high!
Eight cells. They were humming, like they wanted to go somewhere.
They're tuned to a signal. Somebody is collecting them.
Oh no, it's happening again. The machines are lifting off!
Get close to anything with a pink ring under it and press PIN. Your watch will pull it back down.
Do not let the drinks escape!
Wait. The big screens. Somebody has taken them over!
Good evening, Tokyo. I am Professor Zero, and I have borrowed your gravity.
Every country will pay me one gold bar, or everything they own floats off into space. Toodle-oo!
He waved at us. With a floating teacup.
Professor Zero. He was laughed out of the Space Academy for inventing floating shoes. It seems he has been busy since.
Zero's robots are in the cherry blossom park, sticking gravity leeches to the trees!
These ones run away. Sneak up on them and ZAP.
They floated off going wheee. I think they enjoyed it.
One of them dropped this. It's a map of the tower with rings drawn on it.
BOLT has rocket feet! BOLT, fly up the rings round the tower and scan the top.
Rocket feet ready. Mostly ready.
Rory, you steer him. Hold JUMP to go up, let go to come down.
I found the machine on the top! It says Property of Professor Zero. Also it says Made in Egypt.
Egypt? Then that's where we go next.
The cells are all over the step pyramid. Each step is one big jump.
Climb all the way to the top. The last one is up high, so jump!
There's a crate up here stamped ZERO INDUSTRIES. With a picture of a Floater on it.
Zero Industries? They rented the old tomb last summer. They said they were making hats.
The Floaters knocked the capstone blocks off the plinth. Could you put them back, please?
GRAB a block, carry it to the green circle and DROP it. Four blocks!
Perfect. My grandad will be so pleased.
I would like a grandad.
Zero's workshop is inside the old tomb. But it's full of lasers now.
Don't touch the red beams. Jump over the low ones, and wait for the moving ones to pass.
Plans! For something called a Gravity Pump. It's enormous.
If he builds that, he could lift whole cities.
Oh! You found my plans. How rude. Floaters, take the buggy and run!
A Floater is getting away across the dunes with the rest of the plans!
Jump in the buggy. It drives itself forward. Steer with the stick, pull back to brake, and press JUMP for a boost.
Bump the Floater three times!
Got them! The plans say the Pump's parts are shipped from Sydney.
Sydney. I like the Opera House. It looks like sails. Or bread.
Zero's machine is pointed at the beach. The umbrellas and surfboards are floating off!
PIN them down before they get too high.
Beach saved! You're a legend.
I am also a legend.
The cells are riding on the ferries! Jump from the end of a wharf onto a ferry as it goes past.
One on each deck and one on each roof. Try not to fall in, the water's freezing!
These cells have labels on them. DESTINATION: RIO.
Rio de Janeiro. Zero is gathering everything in one place.
Something is hanging under the Harbour Bridge. BOLT, can you fly out and have a look?
Rocket feet: go.
It was a Floater. Stuck. I told it to have a nice day.
It had a key card. ZERO SHIPPING, back gate. That's the warehouse by the quay.
That's Zero's warehouse. Guard bots with searchlights walk round inside.
Stay behind the crates and out of the yellow light. The shipping list is in a silver case at the back.
Got it! Everything is being shipped to Rio, for the carnival.
A carnival? Zero's going to hide the parts in the parade floats!
Some of the dancers in the parade are Floaters in disguise! You can tell. They can't samba.
Bubble six of them. They run fast here, so corner them.
The last one dropped a ticket. For the cable car up Sugarloaf Mountain.
The cells are going up the mountain in the cable cars. Climb the station stairs and ride up on a roof.
Grab the ones on the cars and the ones on the stations!
From up here you can see the whole bay. And a giant robot in the stadium.
That's the Big Floater show! Except, I don't think it's a show.
Wait! A Floater is driving off with the key to the stadium!
Chase it round the avenue in the kart. Three bumps!
Got it! Now the Big Floater can't lock us out of the stadium.
Ah, Agent Rory. Meet my masterpiece: the Big Floater! Big Floater, sit on him. Gently.
When it stomps, a ring rolls out along the ground. JUMP over it!
After a stomp it gets stuck for a moment. Run round behind it and ZAP the pink battery on its back!
It's floating away in a giant bubble.
My masterpiece! You'll pay for that, Agent Rory. Well, not pay. I don't need your money. Everybody else's, though.
Well done, Agent Rory. The Floaters are dealt with. Now we find the Pump.
Here we go again. The taxis in Times Square are lifting off!
PIN them down, Rory. The hot dog carts too. Especially the hot dog carts.
The drivers say thank you. Well, one of them shouted something. I think it was thank you.
The cells are on the rooftops by the park. Ride the window cleaner's lift up, then the pink pads take you higher.
Don't look down. Actually, look down a bit. So you don't fall.
From up here I can see a door in the pavement with a Z on it.
That's Zero's factory! But it needs power to open, and he's switched off the whole square.
The power box for Times Square is right here. Zero scrambled all the wires.
Tap the tiles to turn them until the power runs from the battery to the lock.
The screens are back on! Everybody's cheering!
Ahem. Excuse me, Times Square. Professor Zero here. My factory is closed today. Go away.
His van is leaving the factory! It's full of parts!
Take my uncle's taxi! He won't mind. He might mind a little.
Chase the van round the blocks. Three bumps and it's ours!
Got it! The van's full of battery parts. They say BATTERY TEST: KENYA.
A battery? I have a battery. It is small but brave.
Oh no, here they go! The zebras, the giraffes, even the elephants!
PIN them down, gently. Very gently. They are very cross.
One elephant is still sulking. But she's on the ground.
I also sulk when I float.
A Floater stole my mum's radio! It's getting away in a jeep!
Take the ranger's jeep. The hills are bumpy, so hold on. Three bumps!
Mum's radio! And the Floater left a map of the watering hole, with crosses on it.
The Floaters are putting gravity leeches round the watering hole, where the animals drink.
Bubble all six. They're quick, so chase them into the water's edge.
The animals can drink in peace. Look, the zebras are coming already.
The tower's control box has a code lock. It plays a tune, and you play it back.
Listen carefully. Then turn that thing off!
The lightning's stopped. The battery cells have gone dark.
My battery tower! Do you know how long that took to build? Three whole Tuesdays!
He sounds very grumpy for someone who stole the gravity.
The cells are spread all along the wall. Run the whole way, up the hills and through the watchtowers!
Some are up high inside the towers, so jump for them.
The wall's stopped wobbling! But listen. The temple gong is ringing all by itself.
Zero's robots rigged our temple bells to send his signals. They play a tune over and over.
Play the tune back to jam the signal. It gets longer each time.
Silence. Beautiful silence.
I liked the tune. I will hum it later.
The relay's signal bounces off the lanterns along the wall. BOLT, fly through every one to scramble it.
Scrambling. Like eggs.
All scrambled. The relay is now very confused.
The fort doors just opened by themselves. I think that means come in.
The relay room is at the back of the fort. Zero filled it with lasers.
Same as Egypt, only faster. Jump the low ones, wait for the moving ones.
The relay! It's sending orders to India. To the gardens of the Taj Mahal.
Stop poking my relays, Agent Rory! I am trying to steal the world's gravity in peace!
The hatch to the workshop is at the far end of the west garden. Three guard bots walk the paths between the hedges.
Hide behind the hedges. Wait for the lights to pass, then go through the gaps.
The hatch! It's locked with a power lock.
And the fountain in the east garden has been pulled apart. I think the lock and the fountain are connected.
The Floaters took the fountain stones and scattered them round the garden.
GRAB them and stack four back on the fountain. The fountain powers the hatch lock.
Water's flowing again! Listen, the hatch just clicked.
Last step, Rory. Turn the tiles and connect the fountain's power to the hatch.
It's open. There are blueprints everywhere. And a model of the Pump... on an island shaped like a Z.
Get out of my workshop! Those are my private doodles!
His robots are climbing the minarets to signal the island! Stop them!
The robots left signal cells on the minaret balconies. The air round them is so floaty you can jump and jump.
Bounce up off the pink pads, then keep jumping in the bubbles. Get every cell!
Signals stopped. Zero's island won't know we're coming.
I will be very quiet. Beep. Sorry.
The beach is fenced with lasers. The only way in is straight through.
They're fast here. Watch the pattern, then go.
Through! The base is up the path.
Who let him through the laser fence? Floaters! Guard the yard!
The silo codes are in a case at the back of the yard. Two guards with searchlights.
Keep to the walls and behind the crates. Wait for them to walk away.
Got the silo codes!
I was very quiet. I did not beep once. Beep.
The silo control panel. Connect the power to the door lock and we can get to the rocket.
The doors are opening!
No, no, no! Floater Prime, deal with him! I have a launch to do!
Meet Floater Prime, the biggest and best of my Floaters. Prime, squash him flat. Politely.
Same trick as Rio, Rory. Jump the rings, then zap the battery on its back when it's stuck. Four hits this time!
Floater Prime is floating off in a bubble!
Too late, Agent Rory! Three, two, one... launch!
The rocket! It's taking the Pump up into space!
From orbit, my Pump can reach the whole world. Toodle-oo!
Agent Rory. How would you feel about going to space?
I've been waiting my whole life for someone to ask me that.
Somebody has scrambled the launch computer. I think we know who.
It wants the launch sequence played back. Watch the lights, then repeat.
Launch computer is happy. Next, the gantry. Zero's Floaters left things up there.
The red tower beside the rocket is the gantry. Stairs zig-zag up the side, and the yellow lift goes all the way up.
There are cells on every level, and one on the stairs. Climb, or ride the lift and hop off.
Gantry's clear. Now let's check the rocket for any more surprises.
BOLT, can you fly up round the rocket and scan it on the way?
Rocket feet, meet rocket. Rocket, meet rocket feet.
The rocket is clean. Except for one Floater sticker. I took it off.
Wait. There's a Floater heading for the fuel line with a spanner!
Take the buggy! It's going round the ring road. Stop it before it reaches the pad!
Three bumps, Rory. You know the drill.
Got it! And its spanner.
Then we are go for launch. Suit up, Agent Rory!
Zero's Floaters stuck cells on the solar wings, above the deck. Fly up with the jetpack and grab them.
Don't drift too far. Space is very big.
Flying is the best thing ever.
I agree. Beep.
The station's power runs through this box. Reroute it away from the Pump.
The Pump's slowing down. Zero's going to notice that.
Who is fiddling with my wires? Floaters! Deck! Now!
Here they come. Bubble six Floaters before they reach the power box.
They floated away into space. They look happy out there.
The airlock to the Pump controls is full of lasers. Walk, don't fly. Jetpacks and lasers don't mix.
Through. And there's a crate of spare parts floating off the deck!
The Pump is pulling loose things off the deck. If they float away we'll never get them back.
PIN them down, Rory!
Deck secure. Now the Pump controls.
The Pump's off switch has a code lock. It's a long one, Rory. Seven notes.
I will hum along. Quietly.
The beam's gone! The Pump's switched off!
Everything on Earth is floating back down. Slowly, but it's happening!
BOLT, fly round the Pump's ring and scan it. We need to know where its battery is.
Flying round a giant space doughnut. Best day.
The scan says: battery on the Moon. In a crater. Next to a sign that says ZERO'S MOON BASE, KEEP OUT.
Subtle.
Zero's console has the Moon base codes. Two guards. Sneak between the crates.
Moon base codes, got them!
My codes! Right. That's it. I'm going home.
The lander carried a moon buggy. Cells from the Pump have rained down all over these craters.
Drive over every one. The buggy bounces a lot up here, so go easy on the bumps.
That was the best drive of my entire life.
I was not in the buggy. I watched. It looked good.
More cells round the rim of that crater, and some up high. The gravity's so low you can jump really far.
Jump like a kangaroo. A space kangaroo.
Got them. The battery's losing power without its cells.
We need to talk to Earth, and Zero's jamming the radio. Stack four blocks on the pad to build a signal tower.
They're light up here, so they bounce. Drop them gently.
Agent Rory! We can hear you. Everyone on Earth is watching. No pressure.
Hi, everyone!
The battery is pulling our kit off the ground. Crates, fuel barrels, everything.
PIN it down before it floats off into space!
Kit's secure. Zero's rover just left his base. He's heading for the battery!
You'll never catch me, Agent Rory! My rover has cup holders!
Buggy, Rory! Round the craters after him. Three bumps!
Stop bumping me! Fine. Fine! I'm going inside!
He's gone into his base.
His base entrance is full of lasers. The fastest ones yet.
You have done this many times. You are a laser expert.
I'm in. There's the battery control panel.
Connect the power to the breaker and the battery shuts off for good.
The battery's dark. The gravity's going home!
My battery! My beautiful battery! Right. You leave me no choice. Mega Floater, activate!
Behold the Mega Floater! I'm driving it myself! Look, it has my face on it!
Last one, Rory. Jump the rings, zap the battery on its back. Five hits!
You can do it. I believe in you. I have a whole program about it.
Oh. Oh dear. I appear to be in a bubble.
It's over, Professor Zero.
I only wanted people to like my floating shoes.
Professor Zero, POLARIS has a proposal. Come and build your floating shoes for us. As toys. With the gravity left where it belongs.
...Toys? Children would play with my shoes? Oh. Oh, that's rather wonderful.
Agent Rory. BOLT. The world has its gravity back. Well done, both of you.
Agent Rory. Something very odd is happening all over the world.
Things are floating. Buses, benches, a whole lighthouse in Norway. Somebody is stealing gravity.
So I built you a partner! Rory, meet BOLT.
Hello Rory! I am BOLT. I am ninety-nine percent ready.
What's the other one percent?
Walking. Mostly walking.
Let's get you both trained. Follow the glowing beacons!
Good work. Now, the first floating landmark has turned up in Tokyo. The plane is waiting.
Agent Rory! Welcome to Tokyo. Look up. No, higher.
Tokyo Tower is floating!
Since last night. And the vending machines keep drifting away down the street.
I would like one drink, please, before it leaves.
Rory, something on the rooftops is soaking up the gravity. Follow the beacons.
Look! The tower is settling back down. Thank you, Rory. Thank you, BOLT.
You are welcome. I did the flying.
Those cells were being sent somewhere hot and sandy. Egypt, Agent Rory. The pyramids are acting very oddly.
Agent Rory! Thank goodness you're here. The top of the Great Pyramid has floated off!
It's just hanging there in the sky.
And the stones keep going round and round it, like a merry-go-round.
I would like to go on the merry-go-round.
Zero's machine was made here, Agent Rory. Find out who built it.
The top of the pyramid is sinking back down. Slowly, but it's coming!
Excellent work. Sydney next, Agent Rory. Pack a sun hat.
G'day, Agent Rory! You're just in time. The Opera House roof has come unstuck!
It's bobbing up and down like a boat.
And the ferries are floating above the water now. The passengers love it. The captains don't.
I love it.
Zero's parts are shipped from here, Rory. Find out where they're going.
The roof's back on and the ferries are in the water. Thanks, mate!
Rio de Janeiro, Agent Rory. It's carnival week. Zero will be hard to spot in a crowd, but his robots dance terribly.
Olá, Agent Rory! Welcome to the carnival!
Why is that parrot float hovering?
Everything is hovering this year. The drummers had to tie their drums down.
Boom. Boom. Boom.
Zero's parts are hidden in the parade, and his robots are dancing in it. Badly.
Obrigado, Rory! Come back next year. The carnival will be on the ground by then.
The Big Floater had a delivery note inside it. New York, Agent Rory. That's where the Pump is being built.
Chapter two, Agent Rory. Zero Industries has a factory somewhere under Times Square. That's where the Pump is being built.
Yo, Agent Rory! Welcome to New York. Watch out for the taxis. They're flying. I mean it.
And the Statue of Liberty's torch is floating above her hand.
She's still holding the flame, sort of. Also, all the screens just went dark.
New York, New York. I would like a hot dog. I cannot eat hot dogs.
Lights on, taxis down, Floater caught. Not bad for a Tuesday!
The Floater's van was full of parts labelled BATTERY TEST: KENYA. Off you go, Agent Rory.
Jambo, Agent Rory! I'm Wanjiru. My mum is the ranger here.
Something is very wrong. The animals keep floating up off the ground. The elephants are furious.
What's that tower with lightning coming out of it?
It appeared last week. Zero's robots guard it. They say it's a battery test.
I do not like that battery. It is showing off.
The animals are back on the ground where they belong. Asante sana, Rory!
The tower's computer was talking to a relay on the Great Wall of China. Zero must be controlling the Pump from there.
Nǐ hǎo, Agent Rory! I'm Mei. My family has looked after this part of the Great Wall for a hundred years.
And now bits of it keep floating off! Zero's relay is in the big fort at the far end.
Then we walk the wall.
It is very long. I will walk the first bit. Then you can carry me.
Xièxie, Rory! Come back one day and walk the whole wall properly.
India next, Agent Rory. The relay was talking to a secret workshop under the gardens of the Taj Mahal.
Namaste, Agent Rory! I'm Arjun. I show visitors round the gardens. Well, I did, until the robots came.
They walk the west garden all night with searchlights. And the air round the minarets has gone all floaty.
Zero's workshop is under here somewhere.
This is the most beautiful building I have ever seen. I have seen four.
Dhanyavaad, Rory! The gardens are ours again.
The workshop plans say the Pump is finished, and it's on Zero's own island. This is it, Agent Rory. His secret base.
Rory, you're on Zero's island. It's shaped like a Z. Of course it is.
BOLT's scanner says the Pump is on a rocket in the silo at the far end.
Stop that launch, Agent Rory. Whatever it takes.
It is raining. I am waterproof. Mostly.
POLARIS has a rocket of its own, Agent Rory. Get to the launch base. You're going to space.
Space. Actual space.
I have always wanted to float on purpose.
Chapter three, Agent Rory. Moonshot.
Welcome to the launch base, Agent Rory. I'm Commander Hale. I'll be flying you up.
The Pump is in orbit, sucking gravity up from the whole planet. We have to stop it before it's charged.
I have packed. I packed myself.
All systems go. Strap in, you two.
Three. Two. One. Lift off!
We're going up! We're going UP!
Wheeeeeee.
Docking complete. Welcome to Zero's station, Agent Rory. Mind the gap. The gap is space.
Look at the Pump. It's as big as a stadium.
It's pulling gravity up off the whole world through that pink beam. Your suit has a jetpack. Hold JET to fly, let go to drift down.
My feet have rockets. I was born for this.
Enough! You may have switched off my Pump, but its battery is safe on the Moon, and so am I. Catch me if you can!
He's launched an escape pod towards the Moon. Everyone back in the rocket.
The Moon. Obviously the Moon.
Touchdown. You're on the Moon, Agent Rory. Take small steps. Or big ones. Everything's floaty here.
I'm on the Moon. I'm actually on the Moon.
I am the first robot called BOLT on the Moon. I checked.
Zero's base is over by the purple domes, and the Pump's battery is in the big crater. Let's end this.
All three golden bolts here! BOLT is very pleased.
Ah. A proper cup of tea. Splendid work, Agent Rory.
I would like a cup of tea. I cannot drink tea. I will hold one, for the look of it.
Milk, no sugar. The POLARIS way.
Tea temperature: perfect. I checked with my finger. I do not have fingers.
Save me a biscuit!
Crumbs detected. Deploying broom. I do not have a broom.
Did you dunk it? You have to dunk it.
One biscuit, Agent Rory. Well. Two.
Agent Rory. What does the sign say?
Do not press.
And what did you do?
...I pressed it.
Alarm test successful. Everyone is now very awake.
In fairness, it is a very pressable button.
That button is for emergencies, Agent Rory. Is this an emergency?
Weee-oooo. Weee-oooo. That is my alarm impression.
I've wired it to the confetti cannon. You're welcome.
That's Agent Biscuit. He's been at POLARIS longer than any of us.
He outranks me.
The dog says: woof. I have translated it. It means: more patting.
Agent Biscuit has sniffed out forty-two spies. And one sausage roll.
He sat on the self-destruct button once. Luckily it's also the kettle.
Our agents. The finest POLARIS has ever had.
Look at those smiles. That's the face of a team that's just saved the world.
I am not in this photo. I was charging.
The best team I've ever had. Don't tell the others.
I have zoomed in. Everyone is smiling. Mission status: happy.
One day I'll build a camera that floats. For group photos.
Hello, POLARIS, Agent Rory speaking.
Agent Rory! It is I, Professor Zero! Is your fridge running?
Er... yes?
Then you'd better go and catch it! Mwa ha ha ha!
He has been practising that joke for a week.
Hello?
It's Pip! I'm in the next room. I just wanted to see if the banana works.
It works.
Brilliant! Bye!
Agent Rory, this is Admiral Frost. I am standing right behind you.
Carry on.
Which rocks?
Hello, Rory. This is BOLT. I am calling you from over here. Look. I am waving.
POLARIS, Agent Rory.
Rory! Quick question. How do you get a floating shoe down from the ceiling?
Turn the gravity back on?
...Hmm. Good point. Goodbye!
It is a banana. It only rings when it wants to.
It's a phone. It's also a banana. Don't eat it.
Hello? ...Nobody there. Just a lot of monkeys.
Welcome to POLARIS headquarters, Agent Rory.
Your mission files are on the board. Walk up to one and open it.
And there's tea on the trolley. Don't press the red button.
I am BOLT. I also work here now. I sweep the floor. With my feet.
Whoa. The room is still spinning.
Rory is now facing every direction at once.
Again! Do it again!
Look for the tall beam of light, Rory. That is where we go next.
The glowing beacon is where the next mission starts.
I am ready when you are. I am always ready. Mostly.
Drag the screen to look around. Then run!

Operation Eclipse. Where it all began, Agent Rory. UMBRA and the stolen sun.
Meltdown. Baron Kaldera, a volcano, and a great deal of melting ice.
Zero Gravity. Professor Zero, his floating shoes, and a trip to the Moon.
Deep Red. Captain Undertow, the vanishing sea, and a very talkative submarine.
